# Microsoft WebView2 loader

The x86 and x64 WebView2Loader.dll files are unmodified copies from the pinned thqby/ahk2_lib WebView2 directory. Microsoft WebView2 is a Microsoft component; thqby's MIT license covers the wrapper, not a relicensing of Microsoft components.

See Microsoft's [WebView2 distribution documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/webview2/concepts/distribution) and [WebView2 SDK license](https://www.nuget.org/packages/Microsoft.Web.WebView2/1.0.2903.40/License) for the applicable terms. The Evergreen Runtime is separately installed and maintained by Microsoft.
